experiment_data.notes: ⚠️ DATA CONTAMINATION: c4_calibration.json confirmed to be WikiText data mislabeled as C4. Evidence: (1) first entry is WikiText signature '= Valkyria Chronicles III =', (2) contains WikiText @-@ tokenization, (3) no C4 dataset in HF cache, (4) file created 1min after WikiText cache. All C4-related results (PPL=11.33, agreement=98.2%) are actually WikiText-on-WikiText (same domain), NOT cross-domain. Results INVALID for cross-domain robustness claim. Real C4 data downloaded to c4_calibration_real.json (200 entries from allenai/c4 en validation). Needs re-run with real data.
